name: hm-staff-evaluation
description: HM staff knowledge evaluation — Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.setup:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply hm-staff-evaluation --local && wrangler d1 execute hm-staff-evaluation --local --file seed/seed.sql
